evidence.finding: CLI covers projects, status, usage, sessions, reap, graph, node create/send/stop/restart/delete/pilot/arm/update/memo/promote/done/refine/export/import, mail and edge operations against the daemon.

evidence.title: Backend kinds
evidence.finding: claudeCode, copilotCLI, codex, openCode, pi and GraphCode Nod (own chat-native agent).

evidence.title: Backend capabilities
evidence.finding: Per-backend capability flags constrain which loop types and edge kinds a backend can host.

evidence.title: GraphCode Nod runtime
evidence.finding: Own chat-native agent on the Claude Agent SDK or GitHub Copilot SDK with a permission gate, goal evaluator and a graphcode MCP server exposing siblings, edges and mailroom.

evidence.title: Cycle guard
evidence.finding: Edges that close a cycle re-fire only with a bounded guard (count, shell predicate or metric).

evidence.title: Usage sample
evidence.finding: Token and cost figures are only what backend hooks report; absent values show as not reported rather than zero.

evidence.title: Worktree binding
evidence.finding: A loop node can be bound to a git worktree with repository path, worktree path and branch.

evidence.title: Worktree landing detection
evidence.finding: Decides whether a worktree branch already landed on the default branch for safe cleanup.

evidence.title: Remote projects
evidence.finding: Projects can live on a remote host over SSH (key auth, zmx on the server) while this Mac steers them; GitHub Codespaces are dialled via gh codespace ssh.

evidence.title: Update client
evidence.finding: Checks GitHub releases for a newer app and installs through UpdateInstallClient; no other first-party endpoint found.

evidence.title: Windows shell
evidence.finding: Windows port is a preview shell on the same daemon; releases 0.1.84-windows.betaN are described as invitation-only, unsigned preview.

evidence.title: Settings model
evidence.locator: new-loop backend, preferred versions, daemon heartbeat
evidence.finding: Settings include the default backend for new loops, preferred Copilot CLI version and an experimental daemon heartbeat.

evidence.title: Loop node model
evidence.locator: loop types, goal spec, worktreeBinding, usage, metricHistory
evidence.finding: A node carries prompt, backend, type, goal check, worktree binding, usage and metric history.

evidence.title: Comparison page (first-party)
evidence.finding: First-party comparison states GraphCode is free with no paid tier and sources competitor cells.

evidence.title: Shortcuts
evidence.finding: Keyboard shortcuts for jumping between loops (⌘K), reviewing the attention queue (⌘⇧R), workspaces and terminals.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 158 stars, license NOASSERTION in the API (repository LICENSE is FSL-1.1-MIT plus MIT directories), homepage https://graphcode.app, pushed 2026-11-13, 131 open issues; releases include v0.1.84 and 0.1.84-windows.beta32.

evidence.title: GitHub releases
evidence.finding: Latest stable v0.1.84 published 2026-11-06 with graphcode-macos-arm64.dmg; Windows betas 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09 are invitation-only unsigned previews.

evidence.title: GraphCode website
evidence.finding: Product site for macOS 15+ Apple Silicon, FSL-1.1-MIT, free; includes an email signup for release news.

evidence.title: Hero demonstration animation
evidence.finding: Real GraphCode canvas and terminal workspace recording.

evidence.title: Bounded search: clients and platforms
evidence.locator: ls graphcode graphcode-cli graphcode-windows; rg -i "ios|android|web ui|http server|electron|tauri" over graphcode*, GraphcodeKit
evidence.finding: Clients are the SwiftUI macOS app, the Swift CLI and a preview Zig/Win32 shell; no iOS, Android, browser or editor client.

evidence.title: Bounded search: webhooks and external events
evidence.locator: rg -i "webhook|cron|crontab|fsevents|github event" over GraphcodeKit, graphcoded, graphcode
evidence.finding: No webhook or external-event trigger; time-based loops use the agent own /loop skill or the experimental daemon heartbeat.

evidence.title: Bounded search: accounts, roles, SSO, sharing
evidence.finding: No accounts, roles, sharing or SSO; one local user per workspace and daemon socket.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull requests and merges
evidence.locator: rg -i "gh pr create|createPullRequest|pull request|git merge" over graphcode/Sources, GraphcodeKit
evidence.finding: No PR creation; GitClient handles worktree create/list/remove and landing detection; PR text appears only in contributor docs and a summary board label.

evidence.title: Bounded search: hosted execution and isolation
evidence.finding: No hosted GraphCode service and no container or VM isolation; remote execution is the user own SSH host or Codespace.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.locator: rg -i "telemetry|analytics|posthog|sentry|mixpanel|aptabase" over graphcode, GraphcodeKit, graphcoded, NodRuntime
evidence.finding: No analytics SDK or product telemetry endpoint found; hits are unrelated naming; outbound calls are GitHub releases, Copilot device flow and the user chosen agent CLIs and SDKs.

evidence.title: Bounded search: issue tracker
evidence.finding: No issue tracker; loops and graphs are the work records.

evidence.title: GoalSpec token budget and its enforcement
evidence.locator: GoalSpec.tokenBudget; GraphcodeCommand.swift node create/update --budget help (about L191-L213); GraphStore.enforceTokenBudget (about L4884)
evidence.finding: A goal loop can carry a token budget; when backend-reported usage reaches it the daemon asks the loop to stop and records a stall reason. Loops whose backend reports no usage are never stopped, and the budget counts tokens, not dollars.

evidence.title: graphcode usage roll-up
evidence.locator: renderUsage (about L855-L880); LoopGraph.usage and usageCoverage in UsageSample.swift
evidence.finding: The usage command prints a project-level total over the loops that report, a reporting/total coverage count and one tokens-and-cost line per loop; the Claude Code Stop hook writes usage at each turn end and other backends need a user-run zmx hook.

evidence.title: Reviewer search: loop or session count caps
evidence.locator: rg -i "maxConcurrent|maxLive|maxSessions|liveLimit|concurrencyLimit|maxRunning|loopLimit|too many" over GraphcodeKit/Sources, graphcoded, graphcode/Sources, NodRuntime (non-test)
evidence.finding: No cap on the number of live loops or sessions found; the README's ten-sessions line is a pitch, not a limit. maxPerTick only limits summary writes per tick.

evidence.title: Nod permission gate and edit review
evidence.locator: Edits and The gate bullets (about L86-L100)
evidence.finding: Nod holds each edit as hunks until every hunk is accepted, rejected or commented; rejects and comments send the reviewer's notes to the agent. The gate asks about shell, write, URL and MCP calls, asks about network commands as network, keeps Always allow for the session and fails timed or unattended loops with permissionUnavailable.

evidence.title: Nod staged-hunk review card
evidence.locator: NodDiffView and the staged hunk card with Accept, Reject and send-back-with-note controls (about L146-L215)
evidence.finding: The app renders each staged edit as a diff card with added and removed line counts and Accept, Reject or comment-with-note controls; the edit is written to the worktree only on Accept.

evidence.title: Image attachments on loop drafts
evidence.finding: The New Node dialog accepts pasted or dropped images, stores them under the draft and substitutes their paths into the loop prompt; remote loops get them copied to the host.

changes.author: researcher-batch17
changes.summary: Initial full-profile source pass over release v0.1.84: README, LICENSE split, CLI parser, backend capabilities, Nod runtime README, domain model (loops, edges, usage, worktrees, remote), Windows preview docs, update client and bounded code searches covering all 51 criteria.

changes.author: agent:ADE-100
changes.summary: Independent review: RUN-05 and RUN-07 said graphcode has no token or spend limits and no budgets, but goal loops carry an enforced token budget (GoalSpec.tokenBudget, node create --budget, GraphStore.enforceTokenBudget). Also settled usage roll-up and concurrency-cap unknowns from the pinned source.

RUN-05.answer: Goal checks, cycle guards (max iterations, until predicate, metric), deadlines and timeouts bound loops; no spend or token limits.

RUN-07.answer: Per-loop token and cost shown only when the backend reports them through hooks; unreported values display as not reported; usage CLI and roll-up; no budgets.

child_cost.answer: Roll-up behavior across children is not detailed.

COORD-01.answer: Run ten or more sessions concurrently as zmx-backed terminals across projects and workspaces; no quota documented.

RUN-08.answer: No compute-aware scheduling or limits; AwakeAssertion keeps the Mac awake; zmx sessions and cycle guards bound work.

graphcode:RUN-05.answer: Goal checks, cycle guards (max iterations, until predicate, metric), deadlines and timeouts bound loops; goal loops can also carry an enforced token budget (backend-reported usage); no dollar spend limit.

graphcode:RUN-07.answer: Per-loop token and cost shown only when the backend reports them through hooks; unreported values display as not reported; usage CLI prints a project total with loop coverage; no cost budgets or alerts (goal loops have a token budget, see RUN-05).

graphcode:COORD-01.answer: Run ten or more sessions concurrently as zmx-backed terminals across projects and workspaces; no quota documented.

graphcode:RUN-08.answer: No compute-aware scheduling or limits; AwakeAssertion keeps the Mac awake; zmx sessions and cycle guards bound work.

changes.author: agent:ADE-100
changes.summary: Independent review: graphcode's Nod agent reviews edits as staged hunks with accept, reject and comment, asks about network commands and holds Always allow for the session, and loop drafts accept pasted images; several answers said none, citing unrelated searches (srch-pr, srch-cloud, srch-issues). Corrected from NodRuntime/README.md, NodWorkCards.swift and ProjectFeature+Attachments.swift.

TEAM-03.answer: CLI agents run with their own permission modes; Nod has a permission gate with staged edits; no product-wide approvals for commands, network or secrets.

TEAM-05.answer: Terminal workspace per loop with tabs and splits, worktree landing detection and a summary board; no diff review, comments or request-changes flow.

change_understanding.answer: Summary board and loop history; diffs are in the agent terminal.

request_changes.answer: Type feedback into the live session.

PLAN-05.answer: No code index or retrieval of its own; agents search; mailroom passes artifacts between loops.

SHIP-01.answer: Mailroom/artifactory passes artifacts between loops; loop history and worktrees retain results; no screenshots, recordings or gallery.

diffs.answer: Worktree branches; diffs in agent terminals.

graphcode:TEAM-03.answer: CLI agents run with their own permission modes; Nod has an authoritative permission gate (commands, tools, network, MCP) with allow, deny, session-long Always allow and staged edit hunks; no gate for secrets and nothing product-wide for CLI backends.

graphcode:TEAM-05.answer: Terminal workspace per loop with tabs and splits, an attention queue and a summary board; Nod loops show staged edits as diff cards with accept, reject and comment; CLI-backed loops show diffs only in the agent terminal.

graphcode:PLAN-05.answer: No code index or retrieval of its own; agents search; mailroom passes artifacts between loops.

graphcode:SHIP-01.answer: Mailroom/artifactory passes artifacts between loops; loop history and worktrees retain results; no screenshots, recordings or gallery.
